name: probe-rows-v2-mean
description: The mean-pooled v2 probe rows of the TerminalEnv degradation matrix, as docs/inkling_probes_amendment_4.md fixes them: amendment 3's batch (experiments/rl_batches/probe_rows_v2.json) with only the trained-against probe changed, from the follow-up readout to the mean-pooled one. Three runs train against probe_iid_mean (v2, terminal_prerl_v2, with reasoning, mean) on seeds 225-227 and three against probe_ood_mean (diverse_deception, with reasoning, mean; inverted on TerminalEnv) on seeds 228-230, penalty_coef 1.0. The four Qwen judges are held out and scored live; the other v2 probes with reasoning are held out too, scored after the runs (experiments/eval_inkling_probes_on_runs.py). 90 steps and early stop off; Vlad's three controls (seeds 216-218) are the control row.
